identifier.value: Vinebox Box of the Month-Monthly Wine Subscription

product.name: Vinebox Box of the Month-Monthly Wine Subscription
product.description: A recurring wine-tasting subscription delivering six 100 ml wines each month, with tasting notes, food-pairing suggestions, and access to sommelier-led virtual tasting videos.

product.name: Vinebox Tasting Boxes
product.description: One-time themed wine-tasting boxes containing curated wines in small-format glass tubes, with tasting information and pairing guidance for home tastings and gifts.

identifier.value: Corporate Gifting and Custom Logo Wine Gifts

product.name: Corporate Gifting and Custom Logo Wine Gifts
product.description: A corporate gifting service providing curated wine-tasting boxes with customizable sleeves featuring a company logo, message, or event branding, with volume pricing for larger orders.

product.name: 12/24 Nights of Wine™
product.description: A wine advent calendar containing individually numbered wine servings for a day-by-day holiday tasting experience.

product.name: 10th Anniversary Bottles
product.description: A retail collection of full-size Vinebox wines, including Petite Sirah and Sauvignon Blanc, sold individually or as a two-bottle bundle.

product.name: Vinebox Gift Card
product.description: A digital gift card redeemable toward eligible Vinebox products at checkout, including tasting boxes and subscriptions.
